summary: Steep narrow street with homes 8-14 m from the kerb all along.
reasons: Homes within 10 m along most of it
Narrow lane beside bush, no pull-off

best_section.where: Upper end of Ironside Street, beside the bush on the east side

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 14-20 m away on the west side, with a garage and carport 6-7 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with bush on the opposite side; no visible pull-off or wide verge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park at the kerb; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Bush to the east shades the lane from morning sun; open to afternoon sun.
